title: Pretraining Reusable Inference Across Views with Synthetic Task Priors
abstract: arXiv:2608.19115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern pretrained encoders make representations from heterogeneous views increasingly reusable, but the procedure that determines view utility and combines evidence is still relearned for each downstream task. Consequently, knowledge about view relevance, complementarity, reliability, and missingness is repeatedly discarded rather than transferred across tasks. We therefore reformulate multi-view learning as learning a reusable, task-conditioned inference procedure rather than a fixed fusion function. Based on this perspective, we propose SIMPLE, a prior-fitted multi-view in-context learner that predicts query labels by conditioning on a small labeled support set. Since existing real-world datasets cover only a limited range of view configurations and task structures, we construct a controllable synthetic task prior in embedding space. translated_title: 跨视图预训练可重用推理与合成任务先验
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19115v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现代预训练编码器使来自异构视图的表示越来越可重用，但决定视图效用并组合证据的过程仍为每个下游任务重新学习。因此，关于视图相关性、互补性、可靠性及缺失性的知识被反复丢弃，而非跨任务转移。为此，我们将多视图学习重新表述为学习一种可重用的、任务条件化的推理过程，而非固定的融合函数。基于此视角，我们提出了SIMPLE，一种先验拟合的多视图上下文学习器，通过条件化于一个小型标注支持集来预测查询标签。由于现有真实世界数据集仅覆盖有限的视图配置和任务结构，我们在嵌入空间中构建了一个可控的合成任务先验，它生成多样化的支持-查询片段，具有变化的类别结构、共享及视图特定因素。
tldr: 本文提出SIMPLE，通过合成任务先验训练可重用的多视图上下文推理器，将视图知识跨任务转移，而非为每个任务重新学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SIMPLE, a prior-fitted multi-view in-context learner trained with synthetic task priors, enabling reusable inference across tasks by transferring view knowledge instead of relearning it per task.
